selected_issues.title: [Bug]: OMP 18.5 startup still times out in 1.4.219 before managed idle title is published

selected_issues.neokod_acceptance_test: Start an idle OMP worker without an earlier turn; observe real provider first-turn start and execution of the assigned prompt. Also test busy main, subagent and RPC/no-UI startup produce no false idle fact.

selected_issues.title: worker-start prompt not delivered to new agent terminals + dispatch capability missing from preamble (1.4.218, Windows)
selected_issues.classification: unconfirmed user report with repeated reproduction
selected_issues.reproduction_evidence: Reporter reports 5/5 depth-one and 3/3 depth-two worker-start failures: written input is unsubmitted, transcript empty, receipt outcome_unknown/turn_start_unobserved. Some dispatch preambles lack a capability.
selected_issues.discussion_and_limits: Later correction rejects the initial top-level-only theory: missing capability also occurred at depth two and is intermittent. No maintainer confirmation in fetched discussion.
selected_issues.neokod_acceptance_test: Track accepted, terminal-ready, prompt-submitted and provider-started separately. Retry the same request after ambiguous delivery without creating a second child; verify every worker can send lifecycle messages using its scoped capability.

selected_issues.title: After runtime restart, all live Dispatches become abandoned and coordinator binding is lost — manual rebind/re-attach required (1.4.218, Windows)

selected_issues.neokod_acceptance_test: Restart server while a parent and detached child run; reconstruct stable parent/child links and actual provider liveness before redispatch. Preserve unknown/orphaned state when no positive observation exists.

selected_issues.title: [Bug]: OpenCode ACP method-not-found leaves steering delivery handles reserved
selected_issues.classification: unconfirmed user report with protocol reproduction

selected_issues.title: Chat sessions fail every turn with set ACP session option "model": "Session not found" (-32603) after heavy system load

Exercise restart-preserved controller, queued opening prompt and switch checkpoint separately; do not equate process presence with session validity.

selected_issues.title: exec: a killed process (timeout/abort) is reported as exit code 0
selected_issues.reported_version: Current main; exact installed version not stated
selected_issues.reported_platform: Reporter examples use sleep; platform not explicitly stated
